build_fixresnet50_model: build a FixResNet-50 pretrained model using the fixresnet_50 function from hubconf
build_fixresnet50_cutmix_model: build a FixResNet-50 CutMix pretrained model using the fixresnet_50_CutMix function
build_fixresnext101_model: build a FixResNeXt-101 32x48 pretrained model using the fixresnext101_32x48d function
load_state_dict_from_url: load a PyTorch state dict from a URL with caching and progress bar support
download_url_to_file: download a file from a URL to a local path with optional SHA256 hash verification
